name: anvilwrought_raptor_first_strike_kills_blocked_attacker_first
notes: Printed: 'First strike (This creature deals combat damage before creatures without first strike.)' The 2/1 Raptor blocks an attacking 2/2: it deals its 2 in the first-strike damage step, the 2/2 dies before regular damage, so the Raptor takes no damage and survives.
